findings.issue: no-new-func flags only the bare Function identifier. globalThis.Function('return 1') (and new globalThis.Function(...)) lint clean in src/bots and src/advice, so the eval-family ban added this round has a one-token bypass. no-eval already catches globalThis.eval and (0, eval), so this is the only gap of that kind.
findings.evidence: In-process lint with the repo config: `export const a = globalThis.Function('return 1');` in src/bots/zz.ts and src/advice/zz.ts gives 0 errors. `Function('return 1')` gives no-new-func.
findings.fix: Add `{ object: 'globalThis', property: 'Function', message: NON_DETERMINISTIC_MESSAGE }` to botDeterminismConfig's no-restricted-properties, and add `"export const f = globalThis.Function('return 1');\n"` to GLOBAL_ESCAPE_PROBES.

findings.issue: Carried from round 2, unchanged. The TSImportType selectors are case-sensitive, but no-restricted-imports patterns are not, so import('../advice/Golden') passes lint. tsc rejects it (TS1149).
findings.evidence: Round-2 evidence still holds. No change at lines 213 or 279.
findings.fix: Optional: add the i flag to the golden part of both selectors, or leave it to typecheck.

findings.issue: Carried from round 2. `import '../engine/hand';` in advice passes, because allowImportNames skips imports with no specifiers. It binds no names, so it gives no data access.
findings.evidence: No change to the advice patterns this round.
findings.fix: Optional: add an ImportDeclaration[specifiers.length=0] selector for engine/hand to the advice no-restricted-syntax list.

findings.issue: Carried from round 2. The TSImportType selector hard-codes LineUpName|SessionConfig|SessionSeat even though SESSION_TYPE_NAMES (line 165) exists.
findings.evidence: Line 165 defines the constant. Line 224 repeats the names.
findings.fix: Optional: build the regex from SESSION_TYPE_NAMES.join('|').

summary: All round-2 findings are fixed. Integrity check: `git diff 68a1fa7 HEAD -- tools/lint/headless-boundary.js eslint.config.js` contains only additions: the MetaProperty selector, the computed-globalThis selector, the setTimeout/setInterval globals, no-eval, no-implied-eval and no-new-func, the JSDoc order note and the reworded comment. Every round-1 allow-list line is unchanged, and eslint.config.js is unchanged. Against the 68a1fa7 config, 2 of the 9 tests fail: the import.meta test and the computed-globalThis/eval test. The other new probes (store-dot-parent, probe-golden-type, probe-hand-state-type) pin behaviour that already worked, so they pass on 68a1fa7, as they should. Each round-2 mutation gap is now caught: removing the bot NON_NORMALIZED_PATH entry, the advice type-position golden exclusion or the advice engine/hand qualifier selector each fails a test. So does removing no-eval, no-implied-eval, no-new-func or the globals declaration, one at a time. Extra in-process checks: globalThis.eval, (0, eval), globalThis?.['x'] and Reflect.get(globalThis, ...) are all flagged in bots and advice; new.target is not flagged by the MetaProperty selector; setTimeout with a function argument lints clean. The full repo lints clean (gate fix-3), the locked TASK-6.21 test passes, and git diff against main is empty for src and the locked test. One new MINOR: globalThis.Function(...) gets past no-new-func. The round-2 NITs are carried over. Changed lines are 429 against a 230 budget (gate warn); the growth comes from the approved Q-2 scope and the fix briefs. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
